caption: A close-up shot of a paddle making contact with the ping pong ball, showing the impact.
positive_analysis:
The paddle moves from the upper right corner downward toward the ball resting on the table.
The ball lifts off the blue surface as the paddle approaches its trajectory for contact.
The paddle rubber and ball compress against each other visibly during the moment of impact.
The ball rebounds rapidly away from the paddle face immediately following the collision.
